prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Rutherfordium (Rf) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a gold-beater's workshop of her element's kingdom — a heavy stone anvil, stacks of thin parchment booklets and sheets of gold leaf drifting in the light
Time of day: midday — bright even light; a bright square of sunlight from the window on the floor.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: a gold-beater look fitted to her body — a low-cut linen chemise, a short leather apron skirt, a wide belt and bare arms dusted with gold, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a work surface, upper body leaning slightly forward over it, hips back and weight on both feet.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a sheet of gold leaf on a soft gilder's brush in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.
Scene note: she is the gold-leaf artisan lifting a sheet of gold leaf thinner than a petal on a soft brush

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — rutherfordium: the first synthetic element past the actinides, sitting below hafnium, claimed first in 1964 by a riverside research town and again in 1969 by a hillside laboratory, and named after a long dispute for the farm-born physicist whose students fired alpha particles at a sheet of gold foil thinner than a petal: almost all passed straight through, a few swerved, and about one in eight thousand bounced straight back, as astonishing as a shell fired at tissue paper returning to hit the gunner, revealing that every atom hides a tiny, heavy nucleus at its heart — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
